verdict.rationale: Yapily's docs cover consent creation, re-authorisation, and revocation is implied only via bank-side flows (e.g., yapily-docs-31 covers re-authorising lapsed consent, not user-initiated revocation), but there is no documented end-user consent dashboard/portal where users can view and revoke which apps hold access to their bank data. Yapily Connect provides consent *screens* during onboarding, not an ongoing management surface.
